Custom programs

Professional learning shaped around your context.

The lab works with school districts, educational organizations, and higher education institutions seeking practical, research-based guidance on AI for teaching and learning.

Engagements can range from invited talks and interactive workshops to multi-session programs aligned with institutional goals.

Typical focus areas

Questions educators are facing now.

Productive & Ethical AI Use

Responsible uses of generative AI for teaching and learning across disciplines and contexts.

Academic Integrity

Supporting student AI use while protecting authentic learning and meaningful skill development.

Curriculum Design

AI-supported instructional planning that strengthens good teaching instead of replacing it.

Equity & Inclusion

Access, inclusion, and fairness in AI-mediated learning environments.

Policy & Guidance

Institutional decision-making and practical guidance for AI implementation and use.

Diverse Learners

Accessibility and the needs of diverse learners, including special education contexts.
